p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi screed spreader is a tempered steel head for pulling sand and cement screed out across a floor before you rule it off. The 500 mm blade moves a lot of mix in one pass and the tempered steel keeps a straight edge under abrasive sand, so you spend less time on your knees with a trowel. Handle not included.

Use it for

  • Spreading sand and cement screed and mortar beds
  • Asphalt and sand mixes
  • Roughing out a bed before screeding with a straight edge

Specifications

  • Width: 500 mm
  • Blade: tempered steel
  • Takes a Raimondi 27 mm aluminium handle, sold separately

Fits

  • Raimondi 27 mm anodised aluminium handles (133 cm one piece, 133 cm sectional or 178 cm)

Good to know

  • The 178 cm handle saves your back on big floors. The sectional handle packs into the van.
  • Knock mortar off the blade before it sets and keep it dry between jobs so it does not rust.
  • Pair it with Raimondi's Kessler handles on your straight edge for the ruling off.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Ipertitina is a heavy duty single head floor machine for tilers and stone restorers. At 110 rpm with tools from 49 to 60 cm it power grouts big floors, grinds and polishes marble, granite and terrazzo, sands timber, smooths mortar beds and cleans and treats terracotta, so one machine earns its keep across the whole job.

Use it for

  • Power grouting floors with the rubber grouting paddle
  • Polishing and sanding, restoring marble and granite
  • Sanding timber floors and smoothing mortar beds
  • Cleaning and treating terracotta

Features

  • Telescopic handle with adjustable tilt
  • Magnetic quick change attachments; takes tools 49 to 60 cm diameter
  • Add on ballast weights for grinding, removed for light cleaning
  • Double suction ports for dust extraction
  • Extra large water tank and dust sealing skirt available

Specifications

  • Speed: 110 rpm, single speed
  • Size: 53 x 73 x 80 cm
  • Weight: 46 kg
  • Single phase 230 V
  • Model: 108 110
  • Made in Italy

What's in the box

  • Hex key kit, user and maintenance manual

Good to know

  • Brushes, felt discs, planetary heads, the 16 litre tank, ballast and skirts are listed separately.
  • The Ipertitina Plus adds a transport cart; a conversion kit (Art. 108KITBAS) upgrades this machine.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Ipertitina Plus is the heavy duty Ipertitina floor machine mounted on its own transport cart. Same 110 rpm head and 49 to 60 cm tools for power grouting, grinding and polishing stone, sanding timber, smoothing mortar beds and treating terracotta, but the cart lets one person wheel a 64 kg machine on and off the truck and between rooms without lifting it.

Use it for

  • Power grouting large floors
  • Restoring and polishing marble, granite and terrazzo
  • Sanding timber floors, smoothing mortar beds, cleaning and treating terracotta

Features

  • Integrated transport cart
  • Telescopic handle with adjustable tilt
  • Magnetic quick change attachments; takes tools 49 to 60 cm diameter
  • Add on ballast weights
  • Double suction ports for dust extraction; extra large water tank and dust sealing skirt available

Specifications

  • Speed: 110 rpm, single speed
  • Size with cart: 55 x 130 x 120 cm
  • Weight: 64 kg
  • Single phase 230 V
  • Model: 108 BIL110
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Takes the same brushes, felt discs, planetary heads, tank, ballast and skirts as the standard Ipertitina.
  • Fit the ballast blocks for grinding and take them off for felt disc polishing.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Maxititina is a single brush floor machine for grouting floors, smoothing mortar beds, polishing and sanding, and cleaning and treating terracotta. Two speeds make it versatile: 55 rpm for power grouting with the rubber paddle and heavy brushing, 110 rpm for scrubbing and polishing. At 26 kg it is a machine one person can lift into the van.

Use it for

  • Power grouting floors with the grouting paddle, then emulsifying the residue with sponge discs
  • Cleaning and treating terracotta and other hard floors

Features

  • Two speeds: 55 and 110 rpm
  • Telescopic handle with adjustable tilt
  • Quick change tools; takes attachments 45 to 60 cm diameter
  • Can be ballasted for heavier work

Specifications

  • Size: 50 x 60 x 80 cm
  • Weight: 26 kg
  • Single phase 230 V
  • Model: 219
  • Made in Italy

What's in the box

  • Hex key kit, user and maintenance manual

Good to know

  • Accessories listed separately: 12 litre tank, 450 mm nylon, abrasive and steel wire brushes, Velcro disc holder, felt discs, grouting paddle and ballast (6.8 kg main plus 3.5 kg add ons).
  • The Maxititina Plus adds a height adjustable transport cart (conversion kit Art. 219KITCRA).

p4.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi planetary head turns the Ipertitina into a grinding and polishing machine. Three or six geared satellite heads spin against the direction of the main plate, which cancels swirl marks and balances the torque so the machine does not pull sideways, and the gearing drives the satellites at five times plate speed for real cutting power with diamond pads.

Use it for

  • Grinding and polishing marble, granite, terrazzo and cement with diamond pads
  • Sanding timber floors with zirconium discs

Features

  • Geared satellites spin counter to the plate, reducing swirl marks
  • Satellite speed is 5 times plate speed
  • Quick clutch flange for fast accessory changes
  • Works to within 1 cm of walls
  • Magnetic and hook and loop satellite tool attachment

Specifications

  • Planetary diameter: 490 mm
  • Satellites: 100 mm
  • 3 geared satellites: Art. 250PL3MONN, about 12 kg
  • 6 geared satellites: Art. 250PL6MONN, about 15.5 kg

Fits

  • Raimondi Ipertitina and Ipertitina Plus

Good to know

  • Raimondi's 115 mm metal and resin bond diamond pads and zirconium discs are made for these satellites and must not be run on the plain disc holder.
  • Fit the ballast blocks for grinding and use the splash ring with water for polishing.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 6 piece diamond polishing pad kit for angle grinders. The 100 mm Velcro pads run through a full grit sequence, so a cut edge on a benchtop, step or exposed slab edge comes up to match the factory polish. Choose the kit matched to your material: agglomerates (engineered stone), granite, marble or porcelain, each with a bond suited to that stone.

Use it for

  • Polishing cut edges and mitres on porcelain slabs and stone benchtops
  • Taking saw marks off visible edges before installation

Fits

  • Raimondi 100 mm Velcro backing pad with M14 thread (listed separately) on an angle grinder

Specifications

  • Pad diameter: 100 mm
  • 6 pads per kit, coarse to fine
  • Kits for agglomerate, granite, marble or porcelain
  • Velcro (hook and loop) backing

Good to know

  • Run the grinder between 1800 and 4000 rpm, so a variable speed grinder or polisher is the right tool.
  • Work through every grit without skipping. Each one removes the scratches from the last.
  • Wet polishing gives a better finish and keeps the dust down; use a cordless or IP54 rated grinder with water.
  • Single pads in 50 to 3000 grit are listed separately for topping up the kit.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 100 mm diamond polishing pads for angle grinders, sold singly by grit. Start at 50 grit to take out saw marks and work up to 1500 for a polished edge on porcelain slabs and stone. Buying single pads lets you replace the grit you wear out fastest, usually the coarse ones, without buying a whole kit.

Use it for

  • Polishing cut edges, mitres and bullnoses on porcelain and stone
  • Replacing worn pads from the 6 piece kit

Fits

  • Raimondi 100 mm Velcro backing pad with M14 thread (listed separately) on an angle grinder

Specifications

  • Pad diameter: 100 mm
  • Grits: 50, 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1500
  • Velcro (hook and loop) backing
  • Speed: 1800 to 4000 rpm
  • Raimondi lists the range as Art. 274FD100G0050 to 274FD100G3000

Good to know

  • Use a variable speed grinder or polisher. A standard 11,000 rpm grinder is too fast and burns the pad.
  • Wet polishing gives a better finish and controls dust; use a cordless or IP54 rated tool with water.
  • Keep the pad flat and moving. Dwelling in one spot leaves a dull patch.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi M14 backing pad is the adapter that puts 100 mm diamond polishing pads on an angle grinder. It screws straight onto the M14 spindle, and the Velcro face takes any of the 100 mm pads, so you swap grits in seconds without touching a spanner.

Fits

  • Angle grinders and polishers with an M14 spindle
  • Raimondi 100 mm Velcro diamond polishing pads and the 6 piece pad kits

Specifications

  • Diameter: 100 mm
  • Thread: M14
  • Velcro (hook and loop) face
  • Model: 274FD100A

Good to know

  • Run it between 1800 and 4000 rpm with the diamond pads. A fixed speed grinder spins too fast for polishing.
  • Keep the Velcro face clean of slurry and dust or the pads will not grip and can fly off.
  • Check the pad is centred on the backing before you start so it runs true.
